name: Dahod

queries.query: Dahod Gujarat official cadastral parcel map land records GIS Bhunaksha AnyROR
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Dahod district Land Records page, which states that cadastral survey was completed across Gujarat and that records are maintained through computerized taluka e-Dhara centres. It links the official AnyRoR land-record route. No open Dahod parcel feature service or safe ID-plus-geometry response was found.

The official district land-record page identifies village/Jan Seva Kendra and taluka e-Dhara record access, but no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint, native parcel identity, schema, or CRS was exposed.

officialSources.observation: Official Dahod district page says cadastral survey was completed for the entire state in 1960 and that land records are updated through computerized applications at each taluka e-Dhara centre; it links AnyRoR. This establishes district land-record custody and procedure, not an open parcel geometry API.
Official Gujarat Revenue Department page lists online land-record and property-card services, but exposes no public Dahod parcel feature layer or geometry response in the inspected content.
Official Gujarati Dahod district administration entry point; the Gujarati route confirms the local government context but did not expose a public parcel service.

Official Revenue Department online-services page was found and inspected. It lists View Land Records and View Property Cards, but no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response or public map service was obtained.
Gujarati official district route was found. No parcel viewer or public feature service was exposed in the accessible page.

The official AnyRoR host linked by Dahod district timed out in a bounded anonymous request. No retry with credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, TLS disablement, or private token was attempted. This timeout is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
